summary: Projecting the translates of τ_N to the vacua above π kills all y ≠ 0.

steps.claim: For every j and vector y: P(ϱ_f(y)·translateDatum(t, j)) = box(y)·ϱ_f(y)·translateDatum(t, j), box the indicator of integrality above the π-places: translateDatum(t, j) is fixed by P because t is integral there (mem_integralAfter: the π-places do not divide the twist's level and are not chosen), and P moves past ϱ_f(y) up to that indicator (projOn_finHeisOp).
steps.lean:
have {j y} : projOnFinPart _ D.piPlaces (heisFinPart _ y (D.translateDatum t j)) =
    boxIndicator .. • heisFinPart _ y _ := Subtype.ext (projOn_finHeisOp _
    (by exact D.projOn_translateDatum (D.mem_integralAfter ht fun w ↦ by grind
    [not_isChosen_of_N_mem, D.isSplitLevel_piPlaces.natCast_mem_iff, star_star,
    w.2.notMem_of_isCoprime_of_mem ϑ.7.coprime_mul_left.cast])) y)
steps.typed_fact:
projOnFinPart _ D.piPlaces (heisFinPart _ y (D.translateDatum t j)) =
    boxIndicator .. • heisFinPart _ y _

steps.claim: Expand pairTranslates and τ_N with step 1.
In the sum over y only y = 0 survives: for y ≠ 0 the vector −y/N is not integral at P (reduction_eq_iff), so the indicator vanishes.
steps.lean:
rw [Fintype.sum_eq_single 0 fun y hy ↦ ite_eq_right fun e ↦
    hy (funext fun i ↦ (D.isSplitLevel_piPlaces.reduction_eq_iff.2 (by
    cases i <;> simp_all [mem_integralBox, idem_mul_mem_Ô, or_imp])).symm.trans (map_zero _))]

steps.claim: For y = 0 the translations are trivial, which gives translateDatum(t, 2i) ⊗ translateDatum(t, 2i + 1).
steps.lean:
simp [← Pi.zero_def, residueOverN, heisFinPart, LinearMap.restrict_apply, finHeisOp,
    stdLattice.semichar]
